headline: Iran strikes US bases in Bahrain; Mexico captures 'El Chapo Isidro'; FBI probes crime database hack

texas.headline: Alpha-linked sports academy is top voucher recipient
texas.summary: Texas Sports Academy, tied to the AI-driven Alpha School, has drawn $6.5 million in voucher funds as of Oct. 30, more than twice the next-largest school, comptroller data show.

texas.headline: Paxton drops transgender-care suit against Dallas doctor
texas.summary: The outgoing attorney general filed to drop his SB 14 case against UT Southwestern pediatrician Brett Cooper, the latest in a series of cases he has abandoned before Democrat Nathan Johnson takes office in January.

texas.headline: Witness disputes state's account of Texas execution
texas.summary: Texas says this week's execution went as planned, while a witness says the inmate's screams showed severe distress.

texas.headline: Texas Tech chair pressed data center firm for deals, report says
texas.summary: The Tribune reports that Texas Tech regents chair Cody Campbell pushed the Fermi data center company for lucrative arrangements.

texas.headline: South Texas town privately backed LNG it opposed in public
texas.summary: Emails show a South Texas town supported liquefied natural gas development behind the scenes while publicly opposing it.

us.headline: Trump vows to work with Democrats on 10% credit card cap
us.summary: The president said he would join the incoming Democratic Congress to cap card interest rates at 10%, a stalled 2024 promise, with the median rate now around 22%.

us.headline: Order tells contractors to consult White House on Congress requests
us.summary: A new executive order directs federal contractors to check with the administration before answering congressional inquiries and to withhold privileged communications, ahead of expected Democratic oversight.

us.headline: Storms on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
us.summary: Forecasters expect storms on the East and West coasts that could disrupt holiday travel this week.

us.headline: Families of fallen object to proposed Arlington arch
us.summary: Some families of service members buried at Arlington National Cemetery are uneasy about Trump's proposed memorial arch nearby.

australia.headline: Wong to frame AI as a national security challenge
australia.summary: The foreign minister will tell parliament on Tuesday that AI is a major foreign policy and security issue, in a speech standing in for a new foreign policy white paper.

australia.headline: Former NSW MP Fred Nile dies at 92
australia.summary: Nile served more than 40 years in the NSW Legislative Council before retiring in 2023, his family said.

australia.headline: Butler orders inquiry into peptide sales
australia.summary: The health minister has ordered a review of how peptides are sold and prescribed, with a parliamentary committee to examine telehealth firms, online pharmacies and social media.

australia.headline: Offline Macquarie Island station slows tsunami alerts
australia.summary: With expeditioners withdrawn and the seismic observatory unpowered, quake detection takes about two minutes longer, though Geoscience Australia says alerts still meet the 10-minute standard.

australia.headline: Strong East Timor quake felt across the Top End
australia.summary: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck East Timor and was felt in the Northern Territory.

australia.headline: HMAS Sydney 85th anniversary events scaled back
australia.summary: Commemorations of the loss of all 645 crew were reduced because the dissolved Shire of Carnarvon could not approve a planned military heritage trail.

ai.headline: Bessent says no new limits needed on older Nvidia chips for China
ai.summary: The Treasury secretary said further restrictions are unnecessary after the administration cut off China's remote access to Nvidia's newest chips.

ai.headline: UN talks on autonomous weapons end with only more talks
ai.summary: Nations meeting on AI-driven 'killer robots' agreed to keep negotiating but made no firm commitment to restrict them.

ai.headline: Google employees protest AI-in-schools policy
ai.summary: Some Google workers are protesting the company's policy on AI in schools.

ai.headline: Anthropic's IPO week coincides with tech's worst week since 2020
ai.summary: Anthropic's record listing landed in the steepest weekly tech sell-off on Wall Street in six years.

tech.headline: FBI investigates apparent hack of national crime database
tech.summary: The FBI is looking into an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center used by police nationwide, a person familiar with the matter told AP; the scope is unclear.

tech.headline: Europe tallies a month of disruptive cyberattacks
tech.summary: Euronews reviews a month of attacks across Europe, from tampered freezers to lost GPS signals and hoax bomb alerts.

tech.headline: Pilotless air taxi carries passengers in Japan
tech.summary: An autonomous air taxi completed a passenger flight in Japan with no pilot aboard.

world.headline: Iran strikes US bases in Bahrain, Iranian media say
world.summary: Iran launched drone and missile waves at US bases in Bahrain, which said it intercepted several, as tankers were attacked near Hormuz and Iranian tankers reportedly massed to run the US blockade.

world.headline: Mexico captures cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro'
world.summary: Forces seized FBI most-wanted fugitive Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Sinaloa, triggering clashes that left at least 11 dead; Mexico credited US intelligence.

world.headline: New COP31 draft tabled as talks run past deadline
world.summary: Negotiators in Antalya put forward a fresh draft to salvage the summit; SBS reports the latest text drops all mention of coal, oil and gas.

world.headline: Bolsonaro in intensive care with intestinal blockage
world.summary: Brazil's former president, serving a 27-year sentence under house arrest, was admitted to a Brasília ICU and is described as stable.

world.headline: Eisenkot invites Likud to coalition talks
world.summary: Israel's Gadi Eisenkot has invited Netanyahu's Likud party to negotiations on forming a coalition.

world.headline: Missile strike on Zelenskyy's hometown kills two
world.summary: A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kryvyi Rih killed two people.

aus-cricket.headline: Australia edge England in T20I thriller at the MCG
aus-cricket.summary: Australia won a close series opener, ending England's T20I winning streak.

aus-cricket.headline: CA says backing Cummins isn't taking sides
aus-cricket.summary: Todd Greenberg said supporting Cummins as Test captain does not mean the board disbelieves Khawaja and Bancroft over 2018, with an independent, sanction-free forum to hear submissions.

aus-cricket.headline: Lehmann denies knowing of sandpaper plot
aus-cricket.summary: The former coach rejected claims he knew of the 2018 ball-tampering plan in advance.

aus-cricket.headline: Carey returns for SA as Peake faces ankle surgery
aus-cricket.summary: Round five Shield squads have Alex Carey back for South Australia against Victoria, who lose Ollie Peake, while Smith and Philippe return for NSW against Queensland at the SCG.

warriors.headline: Warriors host Celtics tonight after 0-5 trip
warriors.summary: Golden State returns to Chase Center against Boston following the 126-98 loss in Memphis, still without Stephen Curry (oblique tear) and Jimmy Butler (ACL).
